verses.original: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־ חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: miḵ·tām lə·ḏā·wiḏ šā·mə·rê·nî ’êl kî- ḥā·sî·ṯî ḇāḵ
verses.literal: A Miktam of David Preserve me O God for in You I take refuge
verses.literalPt: Guarda-me, ó Deus, porque em ti me refugiei.

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־ עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: I said to the LORD You are my Lord apart from You I have no good thing
verses.literalPt: A Jeová eu disse: Tu és Senhor meu; além de ti, não tenho outro bem.

verses.original: לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל־ חֶפְצִי־ בָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: liq·ḏō·wō·šîm ’ă·šer- bā·’ā·reṣ hêm·māh wə·’ad·dî·rê kāl- ḥep̄·ṣî- ḇām
verses.literal: As for the saints in the land they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides
verses.literalPt: Quanto aos santos que estão na terra, eles são os ilustres nos quais está todo o meu prazer.

verses.original: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־ אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־ אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־ שְׂפָתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yir·bū ‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇō·w·ṯām ’a·ḥêr mā·hā·rū bal- ’as·sîḵ nis·kê·hem mid·dām ū·ḇal- ’eś·śā ’e·ṯōš- šə·mô·t̲ām ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯāy
verses.literal: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods I will not pour out their libations of blood or speak their names with my lips
verses.literalPt: Muitas serão as penas daqueles que trocam a Jeová por outros deuses. Não oferecerei as suas libações de sangue, nem tomarei os seus nomes nos meus lábios.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת־ חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mə·nāṯ- ḥel·qî wə·ḵō·w·sî ’at·tāh tō·w·mîḵ gō·w·rā·lî
verses.literal: The LORD is my chosen portion . . . and my cup You have made my lot secure
verses.literalPt: Jeová é a porção da minha herança e do meu cálice. Tu és da minha sorte o sustentáculo.

verses.original: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־ לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־ נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḇā·lîm nā·p̄ə·lū- lî ban·nə·‘i·mîm ’ap̄- na·ḥă·lāṯ šā·p̄ə·rāh ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places surely my inheritance is delightful
verses.literalPt: As sortes me caíram em lugares amenos, linda é a minha herança.

verses.original: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־ לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃
verses.literal: I will bless the LORD who counsels me even at night my conscience instructs me
verses.literalPt: Bendirei a Jeová, que me aconselha. Até de noite me instruem os meus rins.

verses.original: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־ אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: šiw·wî·ṯî Yah·weh lə·neḡ·dî ṯā·mîḏ kî mî·mî·nî bal- ’em·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: I have set the LORD always before me Because He is at my right hand I will not be shaken
verses.literalPt: Tenho posto sempre a Jeová diante de mim; estando ele à minha direita, não serei abalado.

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־ בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên śā·maḥ lib·bî way·yā·ḡel kə·ḇō·w·ḏî ’ap̄- bə·śā·rî yiš·kōn lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices my body also will dwell securely
verses.literalPt: Portanto, está alegre o meu coração, e se regozija a minha alegria; também a minha carne habitará em segurança.

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־ תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־ תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ṯa·‘ă·zōḇ nap̄·šî liš·’ō·wl lō- ṯit·tên ḥă·sî·ḏə·ḵā lir·’ō·wṯ šå̄·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol nor will You let Your Holy One see decay
verses.literalPt: Pois não abandonarás a minha alma ao Sheol, nem permitirás que o teu santo veja a corrupção.

verses.original: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־ פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî ’ō·raḥ ḥay·yîm śō·ḇa‘ śə·mā·ḥôt̲ ’eṯ- pā·ne·ḵā nə·‘i·mō·wṯ bî·mî·nə·ḵā ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: You have made known to me the path of life You will fill me with joy in Your presence . . . with eternal pleasures at Your right hand
verses.literalPt: Far-me-ás conhecer a vereda da vida. Na tua presença, há plenitude de alegria; na tua destra, há delícias para sempre.
